proof_body:
by
  intro m n
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero =>
    simp only [pow_zero, mul_one, integral_pow, Nat.factorial]
    have hm : (m.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    norm_num
    field_simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have hd : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (m + 1) / ((m:ℝ) + 1)) (x ^ m) x := by
      intro x _
      have := (hasDerivAt_pow (m + 1) x).div_const ((m:ℝ) + 1)
      have hm : (m:ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      exact this.congr_deriv (by simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]; push_cast; field_simp)
    have hd2 : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => (1 - x) ^ (n + 1)) (-( ((n:ℝ) + 1) * (1 - x) ^ n)) x := by
      intro x _
      have := ((hasDerivAt_id' x).const_sub 1).fun_pow (n + 1)
      exact this.congr_deriv (by simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]; push_cast; ring)
    have hparts := intervalIntegral.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul hd2 hd (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop) (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)
    have e1 : ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, x ^ m * (1 - x) ^ (n + 1) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (1 - x) ^ (n + 1) * x ^ m := by
      congr 1; ext x; ring
    rw [e1, hparts]
    have e2 : ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (-(((n:ℝ) + 1) * (1 - x) ^ n)) * (x ^ (m + 1) / ((m:ℝ) + 1)) = -(((n:ℝ) + 1) / ((m:ℝ) + 1)) * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, x ^ (m + 1) * (1 - x) ^ n := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      congr 1; ext x
      have : (m:ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp
    rw [e2, ih (m + 1)]
    have f1 : ((m + (n + 1) + 1).factorial : ℝ) = ((m + 1 + n + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
      congr 2; ring
    rw [f1]
    simp only [one_pow, zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero _), sub_self, sub_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul, zero_div, neg_mul, neg_neg, zero_sub]
    rw [Nat.factorial_succ m, Nat.factorial_succ n]
    push_cast
    have : (m:ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp
target_source: ∀ m n : ℕ, ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, x ^ m * (1 - x) ^ n = (m.factorial : ℝ) * (n.factorial : ℝ) / ((m + n + 1).factorial : ℝ)
